summary: Edexcel College is a proprietary single-product PHP and MySQL web portal for timetable scheduling, campus operations, student and parent access, live online classes, lesson recordings, fees, and WhatsApp automation for one Sri Lankan college.

descriptions.domain: Sri Lankan college operations including Pearson Edexcel exam timetables, lesson fees in LKR, and trilingual WhatsApp student and parent support.
descriptions.technique: Courso and WhatsApp assistants answer from live enrolment and timetable rows with Groq or Gemini, intent mapping, and a learned Q&A memory store for adaptive quizzes and chat.
descriptions.architecture: PHP page scripts with a PSR-4 service layer coordinate LiveKit online classrooms, composite egress through S3, Bunny Stream playback, cron-driven WhatsApp outbox and reminders, and a self-hosted LiveKit stack on a separate VPS.
descriptions.testing: PHPUnit unit tests and custom gate scripts cover recording access, LiveKit JWT tokens, OnePay callbacks, Bunny webhooks, and classroom fee paywall rules.
descriptions.environment_and_build: docker-compose runs Evolution API locally, and deploy/livekit bundles Caddy, LiveKit, egress, and MinIO for self-hosted video on a VPS.
descriptions.non_code_assets: Numbered SQL migrations and a compressed Pearson official exam timetable seed for admin import.

notable_components.text: Self-hosted LiveKit SFU, TURN, composite egress, and MinIO stack with Docker Compose for video separate from the college PHP portal.
